title: speicher.md repo / folder config (.speicher.yaml)
description: One schema covers both, because both use the same filename and an editor can only bind one schema to it. Root-only keys are optional here and enforced positionally by the pull-request check: `version` and `ingest_root` are rejected in a folder config. ${VAR} interpolation is never permitted in this file. `content_branch` is reserved and rejected in v1 — branch support is not implemented.

version.description: The format version of this file. Always `1`. Required in the root `.speicher.yaml`; a folder's file can leave it out.

ingest_root.description: Root only. Publishes only this folder of the repository, for example `docs`. Nothing outside it is read, and URLs start below it. Write it without a leading slash.

access.description: Who may read the pages at this level. Required in the root `.speicher.yaml`. In a folder, it can only narrow what the folder inherits: a reader must be allowed at every level from the root down.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for `groups`: a list of group names.

groups.description: Group names whose members may read. Each name must be a group configured on the instance, or `public` if the instance lists this repository under `public.repos`.

users.description: Individual people who may read, each with an expiry date.

maintainers.description: Root only. People who can see this repository's sync status and the problems of its last sync. Maintainers get no read access from this; to read the pages, they also need `access`.

groups.description: Group names whose members maintain this repository. Cannot be `public`.

users.description: Individual maintainers, each with an expiry date.

display.description: How this repository or folder is shown.

title.description: The name of the repository (in the root file) or of this folder. Not inherited by subfolders. A folder's `index.md` title takes precedence.

cover.description: An image shown on this repository's or folder's card, as a path relative to this file. It must be inside the repository and must not be an SVG. Subfolders inherit it; `null` removes an inherited cover.

indexable.description: Set to `false` to leave these pages out of AI assistant search, the sitemap and search engines. Pages can still be read and found in speicher.md's own search. Once turned off, a subfolder cannot turn it back on.

include.description: The include list determines which files will be downloaded from the git repository. Markdown files will be displayed as pages in the reader, while other files such as images can be linked from pages. It defaults to `.md`, `.mdx`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.avif` and `.svg` files. Patterns start at `ingest_root`: with `ingest_root: docs`, the pattern `guides/*.md` selects `docs/guides/*.md`. In a folder, it replaces the inherited list.

exclude.description: The exclude list determines which files will not be downloaded, even when the include list selects them. It defaults to `**/README.md`. Patterns start at `ingest_root`, as in the include list. In a folder, it adds to the inherited list.

userGrant.description: One person, named by `email` or by `subject` with a `note`.

oneOf.description: Opaque identity. `note` is mandatory — a bare identifier is unauditable.

provider.description: Short id of the identity provider the person signs in with. Can be left out when the instance has one provider or sets `auth.default_provider`.

subject.description: The person's permanent id at the identity provider, the value of its subject claim. It never changes and is never reused. For a magic-link provider, it is the email address. Needs a `note`.

email.description: The person's email address, matched against the address the identity provider reports at sign-in. If the provider has a directory, it is resolved to the person's subject id during each sync.

note.description: Who this grant is for, such as a name and role. Required with `subject`. Up to 200 characters.

until.description: Date the grant ends, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. It is valid until the end of that day (UTC). The repository then syncs again and the grant is dropped.
